candidate: exact independently accepted metadata successor and its reviewed tree; substitute commit/tree only after guarded commit
effects: Verify clean candidate, exact reviewed tree and closed source chain ancestry.
Create local dev at the accepted candidate from the observed remote dev ancestor; retain current task checkout.
Push only refs/heads/dev non-forcibly, then verify remote hash/tree and set local dev upstream to origin/dev.
protected_scope: No main change, other task ref updates, tag, release, protection, deletion, reset or force push.
fresh_guards: exact HEAD, branch, tree and clean index/worktree
single checkout and no dev workspace owner
shared runner dispatch and no active reservation
fresh remote dev/main and matching local/remote-tracking identities
source/code/export bytes identical to accepted source base; only reviewed administrative packet/intake/context/index differences
recovery: If any effect response is uncertain inspect actual local and remote refs before retry; preserve local candidate and do not reset or force. Stop only the affected synchronization if changed source/refs/protection requires new review.
source_release_boundary: Old derived pack checksums pass but source provenance is stale; retain that FAIL. Dev source sharing only; no main or distribution claim.
